description: This file contains the implementation of ResponseValidator class used for response validation and session management in Spark SQL connect client, including response verification, session ID handling, and stream observer wrapping.

classes.name: ResponseValidator
classes.description: A class that manages server session validation, response verification, and stream observer wrapping for Spark SQL connect client.

methods.name: getServerSideSessionId
methods.description: Returns the current server-side session ID.

methods.name: hijackServerSideSessionIdForTesting
methods.description: Modifies the server-side session ID for testing purposes.

methods.name: isSessionValid
methods.description: Checks if the current session is valid.

methods.name: verifyResponse
methods.description: Verifies a response message, checking session ID consistency and handling specific exceptions.

methods.name: wrapIterator
methods.description: Wraps a CloseableIterator with a version that verifies responses during iteration.

methods.name: wrapStreamObserver
methods.description: Wraps a StreamObserver to verify responses for client-side streaming.
